title: Breaking Information Islands in Sparse Tuning via Small-World Connectivity
abstract: arXiv:2610.41665v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sparse tuning is widely used to adapt large language models due to its parameter efficiency. However, its effectiveness depends not only on the number of trainable parameters, but also on the feature-interaction topology of the sparse update's structural support. Limited or uneven connectivity in this support may isolate subsets of feature dimensions, forming information islands that restrict direct task-specific interactions through the trainable update. To address this issue, we propose Small-World Induced Fine-Tuning (SWIFT), a sparse tuning framework inspired by small-world connectivity. SWIFT combines block-diagonal sparse updates for local feature mixing with a fixed deterministic scattering permutation that routes the mixed outputs across feature groups without additional trainable parameters. translated_title: 通过小世界连通性打破稀疏微调中的信息孤岛
translated_abstract: 稀疏微调因其参数高效性而被广泛用于适配大语言模型。然而，其有效性不仅取决于可训练参数的数量，还取决于稀疏更新结构支撑的特征交互拓扑。这种支撑中有限或不均匀的连通性可能会隔离部分特征维度子集，形成信息孤岛，从而限制通过可训练更新进行的直接任务特定交互。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了小世界诱导微调，这是一种受小世界连通性启发的稀疏微调框架。SWIFT 将用于局部特征混合的块对角稀疏更新与固定的确定性散射排列相结合，在无需额外可训练参数的情况下将混合输出路由到各特征组之间。我们进一步从理论上证明，某些随机稀疏更新模型和块对角更新会出现信息孤岛，而……
tldr: 提出受小世界连通性启发的稀疏微调框架SWIFT，通过将块对角稀疏更新与固定的确定性散射排列相结合，在不增加可训练参数的前提下打破稀疏微调中的信息孤岛，从而更高效地适配大语言模型。
en_tdlr: Proposes SWIFT, a small-world-connectivity-inspired sparse tuning framework that combines block-diagonal sparse updates with a fixed deterministic scattering permutation to break information islands without extra trainable parameters.
